children: Nillion's Blacklight L1 mainnet goes live on Ethereum, starting node operations and 0.5% annual inflation rewards. Node operators register fresh L1 nodes with a minimum stake of 70,000 NIL, tying participation directly to the network's launch requirements. The activation moves the network from preparation to operational status, with staking, rewards, and node registration beginning together.

As nodes come online, NIL takes on a functional role in the Ethereum L1 deployment. Renewed staking demand is the expected near-term effect, as operators position capital to qualify for rewards. The 70,000 NIL minimum means participation is weighted toward larger holders, which shapes how broadly staking spreads across the operator base.

title: Ethereum: Blacklight L1 mainnet launches with NIL node staking and inflation rewards - 05 Oct 2026
